notes: 0.3.55：①配置同步面板样式重构——页头拆成三层（标题+本机/云端徽标簇、版本 meta 与说明、右侧操作按钮），卡片/分区/按钮/输入/指标条统一内距、圆角与栅格节奏，分区标题加品牌蓝竖条锚点；状态徽标底色改用随主题翻转的 tertiary 色，dark 下文字对比度由最低 1.84:1 提升到 11~17:1，toast 与启动浮层全部改用 theme token；不新增依赖、不改同步行为。②含 0.3.54 三处性能提速：capture 用批量 FileInfo（大小+mtime）快筛替代逐文件双哈希（五万文件约 120s→约 4s，-DeepVerify 强制全量）；推送前历史超限扫描改为按提交缓存（-ScanHistory 强制全量）；拉取由 fetch+pull 改为 fetch+merge --ff-only，省一次网络往返。
notesEn: 0.3.55: (1) Config Sync panel restyle — the header is now three layers (title + local/cloud badge groups, version meta + lead, action buttons on the right), cards/sections/buttons/inputs/metrics share one spacing, radius and grid rhythm, section titles get a brand-blue anchor bar; status chips now use theme-flipping tertiary fills, lifting dark-mode text contrast from as low as 1.84:1 to 11–17:1, and the toast/startup overlay use theme tokens only. No new dependencies, no behaviour change. (2) Also ships the 0.3.54 performance work: capture uses batched FileInfo (size + mtime) prefiltering instead of hashing every file twice (~120 s -> ~4 s on 50k files; -DeepVerify forces a full pass), the pre-push oversized-history scan is cached per commit (-ScanHistory forces a full run), and pull is fetch + merge --ff-only instead of fetch + pull (one fewer round trip).
